name: wp-timestamp-millisecond-precision
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Touch timestamps come from new Date().toISOString(), which ALWAYS carries milliseconds ('...T10:00:00.000Z'). Golden engine fixtures show second precision ('...Z' without millis).
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #13): millisecond ISO-8601 ('...T10:00:00.000Z') is the FROZEN timestamp format (plugin new Date().toISOString() + ISO standard). Callers own the clock and must pass millisecond precision; the engine stores the string verbatim (documented on ParseAttributionInput.now).
